name: knowledge-os
description: Approval-gated conversational capture for Knowledge OS durable Markdown records, with an explicit one-time companion CLI setup when needed.

interface.longDescription: Detect durable decisions, reusable lessons, and recurring preferences in conversation, batch proposals at natural pauses, and capture only approved records in a configured Knowledge OS workspace. The skill offers an explicit one-time local CLI setup when the companion package is not installed.
defaultPrompt: Capture durable decisions only after I approve them.
